name: crew
description: Crew: Claude Code hands bounded tasks to other agent CLIs (OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, Moonshot Kimi, DeepSeek through Claude Code, or a local OmniRoute gateway), each signed in with its own account, and checks what comes back. Read-only by default; write tasks run in a separate git worktree and land on their own branch. Use it for second opinions and to stretch your Claude usage limits.
